description: Land Acquisition - Correction Notice Gaz. Ex. No. 2270/62 dated 10.03.2022, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 2293/12 dated 15.08.2022 and No. 2309/07 dated 06.12.2022 Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically providing corrections to dates for submission of claims and documents related to land title inquiries. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
